test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He did not provide ________ his brother in his will.
solution:
The correct answer is '**for**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer for the given blank is '**for**'.
 
• Here, **'provide for'** is a phrasal verb.
 
• In the given context it means** 'to have or make plans to deal with something that will or may happen in the future**'.
 
 
• *Example: The plant will have an on-site facility that **provides for **25 years of storage of spent fuel.*
 
 
 
• If a law or agreement provides for something, it allows it to happen or exist.
 
 
• For Example - Current legislation **provides for** the detention of those suspected of terrorism.

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *He did not **provide for** his brother in his will.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए रिक्त स्थान का सही उत्तर '**for**' है।
 
• यहाँ, **'provide for' **एक वाक्यांश क्रिया है।
 
• दिए गए संदर्भ में इसका अर्थ है **'भविष्य में होने वाली या होने वाली किसी चीज़ से निपटने के लिए योजना बनाना'**।
 
 
• उदाहरण के लिए - The plant will have an on-site facility that provides for 25 years of storage of spent fuel.
 
 
 
• **यदि कोई कानून या समझौता कुछ प्रदान करता है, तो वह इसे होने या अस्तित्व में रखने की अनुमति देता है।**
 
 
• उदाहरण के लिए - Current legislation provides for the detention of those suspected of terrorism.
